name: vargus
description: A Claude Code status line fed by a mod: context, limits, tokens, git, written by the mod and printed by a one-line statusLine command

effort.title: Model: effort
effort.description: Add the effort level to the model (opus:high)

rateLimits.title: Rate limits
rateLimits.description: Show the 5-hour and 7-day limits with time to reset (5h:4%(4h37m))

otherModelWeekly.title: Rate limits: other models' weekly
otherModelWeekly.description: Add weekly limits of models other than Sonnet and Opus

context.title: Context
context.description: Show how full the context window is (ctx:20%)

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Show tokens since the mod loaded, the last /clear or resume (token:69.5k)

session.title: Session time
session.description: Show time since the session started (session:24m)

callCounts.title: Call counts
callCounts.description: Show tool calls, agents and skills (🔧73 🤖2 ⚡1)

workflowRuns.title: Call counts: workflow runs
workflowRuns.description: Add workflow runs to the call counts

detachedHead.title: Branch: detached HEAD
detachedHead.description: On a detached HEAD, name its commit or tag instead of hiding the branch

status.title: Working-tree status
status.description: Show staged, modified, untracked and other counts (?4)
